name: Differently Abled Pension
full_name: Destitute Differently Abled Pension Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
summary: A monthly pension for destitute people with a disability of 40% or more.
benefit_note: ₹1,500 a month, credited directly to a bank account.
how_to_apply: Get a disability certificate from a government medical board if you do not have one.
Apply at your Village Administrative Officer, Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body office, or the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
Once approved, the pension is credited to your bank account each month.

all.label: Disability assessed at 40% or more
all.fix_hint: The percentage comes from a disability certificate issued by a government medical board. If you have never been assessed, the District Differently Abled Welfare Office can arrange it.

TRANSLATION WARNING. Amounts and the 40% threshold come from the TAMIL version of the Commissionerate of Revenue Administration page (cra.tn.gov.in/about_schemes_t.php), read through automatic translation on 2026-08-09. A Tamil reader must confirm.

TWO OFFICIAL SOURCES DISAGREE ON THE THRESHOLD. The state Destitute Differently Abled Pension is 40% on the CRA page, and an official district portal (karur.nic.in) gives 40% for the state scheme but 60% for the centrally sponsored IGNDPS — while the CRA page gives 80% for IGNDPS. These are probably three different schemes with three different thresholds, but that has to be untangled before this ships. 40% is used here because it matches the state scheme this file describes.

TO CONFIRM: an income condition. The translated page mentions an annual income limit around ₹3 lakh attached to self-employed applicants, but the sentence did not survive translation cleanly. No income rule has been written rather than guess at one. Find it.
TO CONFIRM: an employment condition. The translation suggests the applicant must be unemployed, which is a significant rule if true. Not written.
This is the first scheme in the corpus with a FIXABLE non-money numeric gap — someone never formally assessed can get a disability certificate. That makes it a good demo for step 8.
